scope: Offline migration verification only; no new model judgments or frozen-artifact modifications.

repository_tests.legacy_browser_test: Local synthetic HTML rendered in isolated temporary Chromium; no user browser or system defaults changed.

bootstrap.sampling: Uniform pages with replacement, drawing the number of distinct input pages
bootstrap.rank_ties: Exact equal scores are ordered lexicographically by model name (no average ranks)
bootstrap.disconnected_policy: Retain all ridge-fitted draws; do not discard or resample

limitations: Numerical reproduction establishes implementation equivalence, not external validation of the proxy.
Deployment bootstrap fixes coefficients and predictions; it does not cover all system uncertainty.
Four-vote calibration and single-vote deployment remain different protocols.
Large raw data and candidate images are not included in this code release; dataset_versions.json authenticates external inputs.
